title: Nourishing Roasted French Vegetable Macaron
description: A resinous and tender Normandy-inspired dish featuring roasted vegetables in a low-fat macaron form, perfect for a sick day pick-me-up.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the carrots, zucchini, eggplant, and onion with the melted butter and minced garlic until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 25 minutes.
While the vegetables are roasting, prepare the bain-marie by filling a large saucepan with water to a depth of about 2 inches and bringing it to a simmer.
Once the vegetables are done roasting, let them cool slightly before spooning them into the macaron shells.
Place the filled macarons in the bain-marie, cover the saucepan with a lid, and steam for 5 minutes.
Remove the macarons from the bain-marie and top each one with a sprinkle of shredded gruyere cheese.
Return the macarons to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
